issue.description:
ADR-001 (docs/adr/001-declared-verification-edges-over-title-heuristics.md) is Accepted but has neither a spec bead nor an implementation bead: no open bead covers the `verifies` edge kind or inverted-verification-gate detection. Work to close the gap: (1) specify R025 under research/specs/ per the ADR; (2) add `verifies` as a third dependency kind an author declares to record a check relationship, extending the §3.4 two-kind set; (3) implement the advisory diagnosis — a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` the bead it blocks is reported as an inverted verification gate — reported only, never rejected at insert time, and never inferred from issue titles; (4) keep it outside eligibility/claim selection, matching R021's advisory posture, and surface it in doctor/lint reporting; (5) plumb the new kind through `bead dep`, the schema, checkpoint round-trip (including unknown-field and restore paths), schema explain/field-guide entries, and help text; (6) add conformance and concurrency tests per AGENTS.md (atomic, auditable — dependency mutations must emit audit events, coordinating with beadrs-633ff22e). Evidence this is real: the ADR measured 21 and 24 inverted edges in two live workspaces, a recurring 4–6% authoring error rate.
